is provided. Base controller proposals only on the task contract, current and
inherited guidance, sampled solver results, inherited optimizer logs, and
current rollout evidence. Do not search for or reconstruct the omitted shelf
from neighboring configurations or repository history.

The successful sampled rollout preserves that wake-entry behavior and roughly doubles upstream displacement, reaching the target at 266.3; I’m tracing the exact controller delta and inherited hypotheses before selecting a single, conservative refinement.

The candidate hypothesis will preserve the fully demonstrated `20° / 0.67` propulsion and posterior bundle and change only the bounded bearing-rate lookahead from `0.25` to `0.35`. At the existing `±0.30` rate clamp, that adds at most `0.03 rad` to the predicted bearing—enough to test earlier unwinding of the visible broad turns without increasing gait effort, posterior lag, steering limit, or actuator exposure. I’m recording this diagnosis and the durable `19°→20°` threshold lesson before editing the policy, as required by the visual-signals skill.
